text: Nia said, “I want the golden cape.” Rafi held the Moon robe. Nia borrowed the golden cape. Rafi said, “I need a Sun costume.” Nia handed Rafi the golden cape. The golden cape's hem was long. Nia said, “I can help you.” Rafi gathered the golden cape's front. Nia fetched the Sun disk from the prop box. She handed the Sun disk to Rafi. Rafi raised the Sun disk. She swirled with the blue ribbons. Rafi hung the golden cape in the costume cupboard. The golden cape shone.
